title: Just this once
notes: Cole's Thursday, at [Tuck's] after the shift. The Discipline Loop break point: negotiating with the standard. The outline's line: "Just this once. You've been good." Going isn't wrong; the test is which card you play once you're there. Claude's draft.
After this, the evening goes on. The night encounter is skipped, since this was it.
intro: 4:00 p.m. [Tuck's]. [Cole] is already ordering. [Gus] sets your usual down before you ask.
open: Just this once. You've been good.

openIf.text: Just this once. You've been good. And you're good at this part too.

tag.item: break point: negotiating with the standard

rounds: One won't count. Nobody's keeping score.
You'll get back on it tomorrow. Just this once.
